confidence_notes: Food estimates use June and November Atlanta readings from [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Atlanta); cocktail pricing is informed by [Square's Atlanta bar averages](https://squareup.com/us/en/menu-pricing/bar-prices-in-atlanta). Wine is estimated from its usual premium over beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, with particular uncertainty around hostel availability and major-event dates. Sales taxes and tips can add to costs.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates draw on large Southeastern US business and convention hubs such as Charlotte, allowing for Atlanta's substantial hotel market and relatively sparse hostels.
